description: Separate strict post-F07 source delta register. The original 518-owner F07 audit and original reviewed Git blobs remain immutable. A changed file is admitted only at its separately pinned current SHA and with its exact new source contract. This is source-change classification, not post-change optimization benchmark, translated catalog completeness, GPU execution, guest progress, or PS5 validation. CI still independently enforces active feature host checks.
